THE PROBLEM WE SOLVE

Every independent hotel in America has Institutional Alzheimer's.

The moment a shift ends — everything your team learned about a guest that day disappears. The room that was too cold. The name they prefer. The problem that was never fully resolved.

Gone.

26 guests stay silent for every one who complains. They do not call the front desk. They check out quietly. They book somewhere else. And they never say why.

A 200-room independent hotel loses an estimated $4.3 million to $13.6 million every year from guests who had a problem, said nothing, and never came back.

This is not a service problem.
It is an infrastructure problem.

And we built the infrastructure to fix it.

A CATEGORY WE INVENTED

Guest Intelligence OS™

Every hotel has a Property Management System for reservations. A CRM for marketing emails. A reputation tool for reviews.

None of them answer the question that matters most:

What does this guest need right now — based on everything that happened before?

Not after checkout. Not next week.
Right now. While they are still in the building.

We call this Guest Intelligence OS — the operating system of guest memory. It sits above every system a hotel already uses. It does not replace anything. It remembers what everything else forgets.

Active Recovery

Guest signals a problem. AI responds in seconds. Staff acts before checkout. The review never gets written.

Persistent Memory

Every guest interaction stored permanently. Every visit informed by the last one. Your team never makes the same mistake twice.

Verified Intelligence

Guest data confirmed regularly. Your team acts on accurate information. Not assumptions. Not stale records. Facts.

WHO WE ARE

Building since 2019.
Shipping since 2026.

HCCGSA LLC is a hospitality and food technology company founded in Philadelphia. We build software for the operators that enterprise giants ignore — independent hotels, boutique properties, and independent food businesses that compete with billion-dollar brands every day without billion-dollar budgets.

We do not build features. We build operating systems. Platforms that sit above what already exists and make everything underneath smarter.

Three years of building. One belief driving all of it:

Independent operators deserve the same intelligence as the largest chains in the world.

“We did not build a guest feedback tool. We built the operating system of guest memory. There is a difference and it matters.”— Nathaniel Clarke, Founder — HCCGSA LLC
